title: Agent decision
description: The AI agent's assessment of a bin reading, returned to the cloud layer and shown on the dashboard for human approval. All field names are snake_case.

device_id.description: Matches device_id on the reading this decision is about.

bin_id.description: Matches bin_id on the reading this decision is about.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the reading being assessed, so a decision can be traced back to its input.

fill_percentage.description: The agent's own fill estimate. May differ from the device's if it judges the raw reading unreliable.

confidence.description: How sure the agent is of its assessment, reached from the reading's quality and calibration fields. 0 = no confidence, 1 = certain.

action.description: What the agent recommends. A human approves or rejects this on the dashboard.

reasoning.description: Plain-language explanation of the recommendation, shown verbatim on the dashboard. This is the explainability requirement -- never leave it empty.

anomaly.description: Present when the agent judges the reading abnormal rather than simply high or low.

type.description: obstruction = something blocking the sensor's view. implausible_jump = level changed faster than physically likely. stuck_reading = identical values over time, suggesting a failed sensor.

predicted_full_at.description: Projected time the bin reaches full, extrapolated from fill_rate_cm_per_hr. Null when the rate is unknown or the reading is untrustworthy.

model_version.description: Which agent version produced this decision, so the decision log stays meaningful as the agent changes.
